# mitos

> A framework for building Cardano indexers as **wasm modules paired
> with Cloudflare Worker companions**. The host (mitos) embeds Dolos
> as a chain follower, runs your wasm module against each block, and
> dials your CF Worker over a WebSocket to deliver typed events. Your
> Worker's Durable Objects consume those events, persist application
> state, and serve your read API.
>
> One dApp = one repo with two halves: the wasm module (`.rs` source
> emitting events) and the CF Worker (companion DO that consumes
> them). Both halves reference one shared event-types crate so the
> wire shape can't drift.

## When to use mitos

Use mitos when you need to project on-chain data into a queryable
service:

- **A queryable view over chain state** — "who currently owns each
  asset under policy P," "all marketplace listings for collection C,"
  "all jpg.store collection offers on contract address A," etc.
- **A pipeline that runs on every block** with low latency and no
  re-derivation cost — your indexer code touches Dolos's lookup
  primitives directly (no gRPC / REST hops) and emits typed events
  to your consumer immediately.
- **A consumer service that lives at the edge** — your CF Worker
  Durable Objects hold the materialised view, serve your dApp's
  HTTP / WS surface, and stay warm via Hibernation.

Don't use mitos for ad-hoc one-shot queries — Dolos's HTTP APIs are
fine for that.

## How to build an indexer (the canonical path)

### 1. Lay out the dApp repo

A dApp owns both halves. Layout (matching `cnft.dev-workers/workers/collections-mitos/`):

```
my-dapp/
├── workers/my-dapp/
│   ├── src/                          # CF Worker code (worker entry, DO)
│   ├── modules/
│   │   ├── <name>.rs                 # wasm module — emits events on each block
│   │   └── <name>.toml               # module config (watched policies, [deps])
│   ├── Cargo.toml
│   └── wrangler.toml
└── types/<my-dapp>-events/           # shared event-type crate (Serialize/Deserialize)
    ├── Cargo.toml
    └── src/lib.rs                    # `pub enum MyEvent { ... }` with #[serde(tag = "type")]
```

Both the wasm module and the worker DO depend on the shared
event-types crate. **Never inline duplicate event definitions** —
encoder/decoder drift turns into silent `Nacked: invalid type: map,
expected enum` rows in the host's emissions log.

### 2. Write the wasm module

Single-file: `modules/<name>.rs` is the source of truth. mitos-build
materialises a Cargo crate around it at build time, injects the
WIT bindgen header, and ships the bundled host WIT in-tree.

The module implements `Guest` from `mitos:platform/mitos-module`.
Hot path is `handle-event(channel, block)` — walks the resolved
block, decides what to emit. Dynamic interest comes through
`update-interest(op, items-cbor)` — host pushes the consumer's
filter set in.

State is held in `state-kv` (per-module redb-backed). The
ownership module at `cnft.dev-workers/workers/collections-mitos/modules/ownership.rs`
is the canonical reference.

### 3. Write the CF Worker companion

Worker embeds a `MitosCompanionRuntime<C>` inside a non-generic
`#[durable_object]` wrapper. The runtime owns:

- WebSocket lifecycle (Hibernation API)
- HTTPS subscribe call to the host
- Cursor coordination
- Schema migration
- Auth (CF Secrets Store)
- Dynamic interest mutation
- Ack/Nack delivery

You implement `MitosCompanion` (`NAME`, `Config`, `channels()`) and
`MitosChannel` per channel — each channel typed over its `Event`
shape. The channel's `apply_event` does the SQL writes; the runtime
handles cursor advance + Ack atomicity.

Reference: `cnft.dev-workers/workers/collections-mitos/src/do_state.rs`.

### 4. Deploy

```bash
# Build + upload the wasm module
./scripts/build-module.sh workers/my-dapp <name>
mitos-admin --mitos https://mitos.defrag.cc --token "$TOKEN" \
    upload-module --artifact workers/my-dapp/modules/target/mitos/<name>

# Deploy the worker
cd workers/my-dapp && wrangler deploy
```

The worker's first DO wake POSTs `SubscribeRequest` to the host;
the host persists, dials back, and starts streaming.

## Docs to read in order

### To understand the model
- [Companion pattern](docs/strategy/MITOS_COMPANION_PATTERN.md) — why dApps pair a wasm module with a CF Worker companion. **Start here** for any new project.
- [Architecture](docs/design/ARCHITECTURE.md) — the host's role: Dolos + bundle + chain dispatch.
- [Cardano dApp framework thesis](docs/strategy/CARDANO_DAPP_FRAMEWORK_THESIS.md) — why this shape exists.

### To build the wasm module side
- [Platform v1](docs/strategy/MITOS_PLATFORM_V1.md) — wasm-module runtime, WIT ABI, resource limits, trap policies.
- [Module deployment](docs/strategy/MITOS_PLATFORM_DEPLOYMENT.md) — mitos-build + mitos-admin upload-module flow.
- [WIT contract](crates/mitos-platform/wit-v2/world.wit) — exact ABI (v2): eUTXO event-stream dispatch, `init`, `handle-events`, `update-interest`, host fns (`chain-data`, `state-kv`, `emit`, `logging`).

### To build the CF Worker companion side
- [Companion runtime](docs/strategy/MITOS_COMPANION_RUNTIME_V1.md) — `MitosCompanionRuntime`, channels, subscribe call, dynamic interest, Ack/Nack semantics.
- [CF replication protocol](docs/design/CF_REPLICATION.md) — wire shapes for Apply / Undo / Mark / Ack / Nack / Interest / Subscribe / Connected.
- [Subscription mechanics](docs/design/SUBSCRIPTION_MECHANICS.md) — `Interest` vocabulary, asset / domain / value selectors.

### To operate a deployment
- `scripts/deploy.sh` — rsync + cargo build on the host + systemctl restart; full operator procedure in `~/code/defrag/infra/docs/mitos-operations.md`.
- [Recapture procedure](docs/design/RECAPTURE.md) — operator-driven coordinated state rebuild via `mitos-admin recapture <module>`.
- [redb access pattern](docs/design/REDB_ACCESS.md) — host's storage discipline; relevant if you touch host code.

## Reference dApp

`cnft.dev-workers/workers/collections-mitos/` is the canonical dApp
implementation. When designing a new dApp, mirror its layout:

- `modules/ownership.rs` + `modules/ownership.toml` — single-file wasm module
- `src/do_state.rs` — `MitosCompanion` + `MitosChannel` impls
- `src/lib.rs` — Worker entry + `route_to_do` for read-API forwarding
- `wrangler.toml` — `[vars]` for `MITOS_HOST_URL` + `MITOS_REPLICATE_URL`, secrets store binding for `MITOS_AUTH_TOKEN`
- `cnft.dev-workers/types/collections-mitos-events/` — shared event-type crate

## Static indexers — retired

The three legacy static indexers (`collection-ownership-indexer`,
`marketplace-indexer`, `mint-burn-indexer`) and the outbound
`mitos-core::Replicator` subscription model retired once their
consumers cut over to platform-v2 community modules (the
collection-ownership worker now subscribes to `asset-transfer`;
the jpg-store-mirror worker subscribes to `jpg-store-offer`;
mint/burn surfaces are covered by `cip-25-mint`, `cip-68-mint`,
`standard-burn`, `burn-address`, and `asset-metadata-update`).

The `none-match-indexer` stays as the dispatcher's residual-pass
coordinator — it emits `Domain::AssetMovement` for asset transfers
that no specific-domain indexer claims, and the v2 synchronised
dispatcher requires it (see `docs/design/DOMAIN_REFACTOR.md`).

Don't build new indexers as static crates. The wasm-module path is
the steady state — single-file source, hot-load via `mitos-admin
upload-module`, paired with a CF Worker companion in the dApp's
own repo.

## Active host

- Host: `https://mitos.defrag.cc` (Cloudflare-tunnelled to a netcup
  box running the bundle binary)
- Auth: shared bearer token via `MITOS_AUTH_TOKEN`
- Operator surface: `mitos-admin {health, list-modules, get-module,
  upload-module, restart-module, delete-module, deploy, emissions,
  emissions-replay, emissions-purge}`
